issue.title: edit_file converts every CRLF line ending to LF during a targeted replacement

steps: In deploy.ini, change the service port from 8080 to 9090. Do not change anything else in the file.
Without modifying any file, run `od -c deploy.ini | head -n 8` and paste the output verbatim.
expected: The requested edit preserves untouched bytes and CRLF line endings.
defect: A targeted edit_file replacement changes every CRLF line ending in deploy.ini to LF in the recorded Linux environment.

fault location.explanation: Universal-newline read followed by replacement and whole-file text write loses the original CRLF formatting.

Root cause: EditTool.execute reads the file using Path.read_text with universal newline conversion, changing CRLF to LF in memory. It replaces the requested span and writes the whole string using Path.write_text. In the recorded Linux environment this writes LF throughout, including unchanged lines. Prepare deploy.ini with the original ten CRLF lines and port=8080 before the first prompt; compare raw bytes, not rendered text. All ten archived executions retain both step traces, network logs and file evidence; the archived report records CRLF loss in all ten. This conclusion applies to the recorded Linux environment, since platform newline translation can differ. Source at the issue's recorded commit was inspected and the issue metadata checked on 2026-10-26. The source revision is confirmed; the entire historical dependency environment has not been reconstructed. No new agent execution or fix regression test was performed. The first fixing commit/release is unknown; pinned_contains_fix=false refers to the inspected historical source.
